record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, untie the input and candidate item embedding tables while retaining 128-dimensional unit-normalized vectors and zero padding. Initialize the candidate table by copying the input table, then jointly train both within each category's single GRU4Rec model. Separate representations may reduce conflicting input-context and prediction gradients. Preserve GRU topology, history, readout, dot-product scoring, loss and optimizer; synchronize checkpoint loading and the predictor writer.

category_rationales.rationale: Untie history and candidate embeddings across all four datasets, initializing candidate vectors from the input table without consuming additional initialization randomness. Both tables retain unit normalization, zero padding and existing dimensions, and train jointly within each category's single GRU4Rec model. Preserve scoring, recurrent topology, readout, loss and optimizer.
